justification: Genuinely novel construction of a lattice field theory directly on the Laplacian-growth process with rigorous perturbative (3-loop) and small-graph checks, though DLA/b-LRW results are deferred and reproducibility is limited by the absence of code/data.

Solid engineering contribution (first GPU-batched NLP solver via iteration fusion and iteration-level batching) with sound multi-benchmark evaluation and open code, but the core idea is an incremental systems advance over IPOPT/MadNLP rather than a new paradigm, and speedups shrink with problem size.

Useful incremental extension of verbalized-calibration training (e.g. ConfTuner) to multimodal medical VQA via a factorial-perturbation design and composite loss, backed by thorough ablations, though it remains a refinement of existing methods and still fails on hard multi-step reasoning.

Well-executed and highly influential PEFT method that adds a principled magnitude/direction decomposition analysis to LoRA, with broad rigorous experiments and open code, though the conceptual advance over LoRA is incremental rather than breakthrough.

Reasonable incremental advance in low-rank rank allocation (local energy + global cosine-similarity metric plus rank-preserving fine-tuning) with decent experiments, but the key geometric intuition lacks rigorous derivation and the method is one of many similar compression heuristics.
